## Behavior and scope

Describe the concrete problem and the resulting behavior. Reference the roadmap slice and relevant design pages.

## Contract and decisions

List existing tables/RPCs/routes used, approved design/architecture decisions, and any unresolved constraints.

## Validation

- [ ] A relevant failing test was observed before the new behavior was implemented.
- [ ] Typecheck, lint, formatting and tests passed.
- [ ] Relevant bundling/native checks passed.
- [ ] Changed screens were compared with the supplied design PDF.
- [ ] Every commit is GPG-signed; GitHub verification was checked.
- [ ] The slice's local PR draft includes exact manual steps.

For documentation-only changes, mark application checks as not applicable with a reason. Distinguish mocked, live-backend, emulator and physical-device evidence.

## Manual device checks

Give short reproducible steps and expected results, including relevant offline, error and role/permission states.

## Remaining limitations

State untested behavior and work outside this slice. Do not mark placeholders or mocked connectivity as complete features.
